text: dsh-webchat-anchor-fix 是面向 DSH Web 客户端的界面修复插件，用来让 WebChat 访客浮层持续贴合对应面板。它通过 bundle 注册浏览器端模块，在 DSH 自身页面安装一段 CSS 锚点样式，把浮层的左侧、顶部、宽度和高度关联到面板元素。样式仅在浏览器支持 CSS anchor positioning 时生效，且面板存在时才应用几何规则；重复挂载会替换旧样式，卸载时会清理样式。适合遇到全屏或窗口切换后 WebChat 浮层仍停留在旧尺寸和位置的用户。不需要额外密钥或外部服务。

dsh-webchat-anchor-fix keeps the DSH WebChat guest overlay aligned with its panel using CSS anchor rules. The rules link its position and size to the panel, helping fix stale geometry after fullscreen or window changes. No API key or external service is required.
全屏和窗口模式切换后，WebChat 浮层还卡在原来的位置怎么办？
想让 DSH 网页里的聊天访客窗口始终跟着面板移动和缩放。
Keep a web chat overlay aligned with its panel when switching between fullscreen and windowed layouts.
dsh-webchat-anchor-fix 的功能「浮层跟随面板」：在 DSH Web 页面为面板和访客浮层建立 CSS 锚点关系，使浮层的位置与尺寸随面板布局更新。通过加载 bundle 自动安装样式，卸载插件时移除样式。
dsh-webchat-anchor-fix 的功能「兼容性与面板条件限制」：仅在浏览器支持 CSS anchor positioning 时启用布局规则，并在面板存在时匹配浮层；不支持时会在控制台提示，页面保留原有浮层几何样式。

dsh-webchat-anchor-fix README · dsh-webchat-anchor-fix：A one-rule fix for a geometry bug in
[`@jaychang1989/dsh-webchat`](https://github.com/jaychang1989/dsh-webchat): after
a fullscreen/windowed toggle the DeepSeek panel can keep the size and position of
the window state it came from, until the guest is reloaded or reopened.

The upstream package is untouched and keeps tracking its own releases. This is a
separate package that styles the DSH web surface's own document.

dsh-webchat-anchor-fix README · The bug：webchat keeps the guest in a fixed-position overlay and copies the panel's box
into it from JavaScript:

- `syncBounds(host)` reads `.dsh-wc-host.getBoundingClientRect()` and writes
  inline `left`, `top`, `width`, `height`;
- it runs on mount, from a `ResizeObserver`, and on window `resize`;
- the overlay itself is never laid out by the shell, so when a fullscreen
  transition outruns the copy, the overlay stays at the old numbers.

dsh-webchat-anchor-fix README · The bug：Because the copy is a JavaScript step, there is a window in which the panel has
already moved and the overlay has not. Nothing in the current design closes that
window; a missed event leaves it open indefinitely.

dsh-webchat-anchor-fix README · The fix：`!important` is not a shortcut: webchat writes the four properties inline, and an
important author declaration is the only declaration in the cascade that
outranks a normal inline one.

`body:has(.dsh-wc-host)` keeps the geometry rule inert when no panel host exists,
so an overlay left behind for any reason still gets webchat's own inline values.

dsh-webchat-anchor-fix README · What it touches：- One `<style>` element in the DSH web surface's document.
- Nothing inside the DeepSeek page: the webview is never read, written, or
  messaged. No `insertCSS` into the guest, no `executeJavaScript`.
- No network requests, no cookies, no `localStorage`/`sessionStorage`, no
  user-agent changes.
- No layout mode, paint or stacking overrides: only the four geometry
  properties and the anchor name.

dsh-webchat-anchor-fix README · What it touches：That boundary matters. The panel bug is a DSH-side layout issue; the DeepSeek
page's risk-control conversation is not this package's business.

dsh-webchat-anchor-fix README · Contract and failure mode：Two webchat hooks are used, both public-facing:

- the class `.dsh-wc-host` on the panel host div;
- the attribute `[data-dsh-webchat-overlay]` on the guest overlay div.

If a future release renames either, the rules stop matching and the overlay
falls back to webchat's inline geometry — exactly today's behaviour. The fix
goes dormant, it does not break the panel.

dsh-webchat-anchor-fix README · Contract and failure mode：`@supports` provides the second failure mode: an engine without CSS anchor
positioning ignores the whole block. The client half logs one console warning
so the dormancy is visible.

dsh-webchat-anchor-fix README · Known limit：This aligns the overlay to the panel element that exists. If the panel element
itself is laid out at the wrong size (a shell-level layout bug rather than a
missed copy), the overlay will faithfully track the wrong box. In that case the
bug is upstream in the app shell, not in webchat's sync.

dsh-webchat-anchor-fix README · Verify：```bash
npm test          # stylesheet shape and restraint, plus bundle registration
npm run test:anchor   # layout behaviour in headless Edge/Chromium
npm run verify    # both
```

`test:anchor` builds a fixture shaped like the DSH shell with deliberately stale
inline geometry, then moves the layout three ways, resizes the viewport, hides
and shows the overlay, and removes and re-creates the host — all without calling
into the package. Every step is measured against the host's own rect.

dsh-webchat-anchor-fix README · Install：With DSH fully closed:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop add https://github.com/dhdkfkfkf/dsh-webchat-anchor-fix/releases/download/v0.1.0/dsh-webchat-anchor-fix-0.1.0.tgz
```

Restart DSH once so the profile boot picks up the new bundle. Mainland China:
prefix the URL with `https://gh-proxy.com/`.

dsh-webchat-anchor-fix README · Install：**Caution:** install this only if a fullscreen or window toggle actually leaves
the panel at the old bounds. If the panel behaves, the fix has nothing to
correct. It is independent of any skin and installs nothing else.

Local development: `npm pack`, then
`dsh plugin --profile desktop add <path-to-tgz>`.

Unofficial; not affiliated with DeepSeek or Anthropic.
